# America's Plumbing

> Licensed C-36 plumbing contractor (CSLB License #0784091) based in San Jacinto, California, owned by Joe Romero with 25+ years of experience. Serving Riverside County and South Orange County with same-day service, 24/7 emergency response, free upfront estimates, and honest, fair pricing. Phone: (949) 379-0082.

Last updated: 2026-07-02

## Key Facts

- Business name: America's Plumbing
- Owner: Joe Romero ("Joe the Plumber")
- License: California C-36 Plumbing Contractor #0784091 (bonded & insured)
- Phone: (949) 379-0082
- Base city: San Jacinto, CA 92583
- Hours: 24/7, including same-day and emergency service
- Service region: Riverside County and South Orange County, CA
- Estimates: Free, written, upfront — no work begins until the quote is approved
- Warranty: 1-year workmanship warranty on all labor; manufacturer warranties honored on parts

## Pricing

- Minor repairs: $150–$300
- Water heater replacement: Quoted per project
- Repiping: Quoted per project
- All estimates are free, written, and upfront — no hidden fees

## Services

- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/emergency-plumbing): 24/7 same-day emergency plumbing repairs
- [Leak Detection & Repair](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/leak-detection): Non-invasive slab and pipe leak detection
- [Whole-Home Repiping](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/repiping): PEX and copper repipe specialists
- [Drain Cleaning & Hydro Jetting](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/drain-cleaning): Clog removal and drain clearing
- [Water Heater Services](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/water-heater): Tank and tankless water heater install
- [Water Heater Repair](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/water-heater-repair): Repair of existing water heaters
- [Fixture Installation & Repair](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/fixture-installation): Faucets, sinks, and fixtures
- [Gas Line Repair & Installation](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/gas-line): Permitted gas line work
- [Sewer Line Repair & Replacement](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/sewer-line): Sewer line diagnosis and repair
- [Trenchless Sewer Repair](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/trenchless-sewer): No-dig sewer line replacement
- [Garbage Disposal Services](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/garbage-disposal): Disposal repair and installation
- [Camera Inspection](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/camera-inspection): Video pipe and sewer diagnostics
- [Hydro Jetting](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/hydro-jetting): High-pressure drain and sewer jetting
- [Bathroom Plumbing Remodel](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/bathroom-remodel): Remodel plumbing for bathrooms
- [Kitchen Plumbing](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/kitchen-plumbing): Kitchen sink, line, and fixture work
- [Toilet Repair & Installation](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/toilet-repair): Toilet repair and replacement
- [Water Softener & Filtration](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/water-softener): Whole-home water treatment
- [Water Line Repair & Replacement](https://www.americasplumbing.com/services/water-line-repair): Main water line service
